profile.headline: Retired
profile.summary:
Results-oriented Software Test Engineer with extensive experience in developing, testing, debugging and deploying software products. An individual contributor who “gets the job done,” and demonstrates excellent diagnostic, troubleshooting and analytical skills. I have shown long-term commitment to my employers and to solving the difficult problems. These include emulation of large numbers of set top boxes, diagnosing customer systems in-service, and detection and isolation of cache/processor errors in complex systems..

Specialties: Leveraging/Adapting great tools for testing RESTful APIs with function, performance and detecting regressions up front

company.name: Triple Crown Consulting for Bloomberg NYC

positions.title: Diagnostic Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed tests and drivers for embedded Linux product, providing DVT and manufacturing support of Battery/Charger, Accelerometer, and Touch Panel test.
Supported and enhanced Contract Manufacturing diagnostics, ensuring proper versions and parameters were used for test.

positions.title: Test Architect
positions.description: Developed C++ and Java tests and tools allowing QA unit, functional, integration, regression, stress and reliability testing of server and database components, ensuring fault free deployments into 1/2 million customer deployments.

positions.title: Principal Diagnostic Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated Cache testing into Data General's product lines.
Project Lead for In-Service-Diagnostics, including dynamic diagnostic load adjustment based on User activity.
Provided training and support to Engineering, Field, and Manufacturing for Diagnostic products.
Part of Engineering Bring-up team for new computer systems.

positions.title: Product Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
QA coordinator for Processor new products (included Test Plans, Design Reviews, Test Phases, Defect tracking/resolution, Test Reports)
PAE representative to Architecture Committee
Member of Bring up team for new processors
Invented Cache Exerciser, allowing resolution of Cache/Multiprocessor Design Issues
